description: This file defines a React component 'Resizer' that provides resizable functionality for UI elements, including handling resize events, rendering resize handles, and styling. It is part of the Notesnook project and uses external libraries such as 're-resizable' and '@notesnook/ui'.

classes.name: Resizer
classes.description: A React functional component that provides resizable functionality with customizable handles and aspect ratio locking.

methods.name: Resizer
methods.description: React component that renders a resizable container with optional resize handle, managing resize events and styles.
